policies.policyname: Users can view their own application
Users can insert their own application
Admins can view all instructor applications
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles
  WHERE ((profiles.id = auth.uid()) AND (profiles.role = 'admin'::text))))

policies.policyname: Users can view their own feedbacks
Instructors can insert their own courses
policies.with_check:
((auth.uid() = created_by) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles
  WHERE ((profiles.id = auth.uid()) AND (profiles.role = 'instructor'::text) AND (profiles.status = 'active'::text)))))

policies.policyname: Instructors can update their own courses
policies.qual:
((auth.uid() = created_by) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM profiles
  WHERE ((profiles.id = auth.uid()) AND (profiles.role = 'instructor'::text) AND (profiles.status = 'active'::text)))))

policies.policyname: Instructors view enrollments for their courses
policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM courses
  WHERE ((courses.id = enrollments.course_id) AND (courses.created_by = auth.uid()))))

policies.policyname: Instructors update enrollments for their courses
policies.qual:

policies.policyname: Admins and instructors can view all feedbacks

   FROM profiles
